acceptanceCriteria: Every row carries exactly one trust class derived deterministically from its source and provider.
A tainted row cannot satisfy an authority, governance or basis requirement; the refusal names the row.
Wire change is additive and consumer tests cover an old consumer ignoring the field.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: rows carry an authority field but no trust or taint class distinguishing project authority, repository history, fetched content and tool output. Add a trust class per evidence row and enforce that a basis or authority claim is never satisfied by fetched or tool-output rows. Prior art: CaMeL arXiv 2503.18813. Owning specs: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md, docs/specs/falsifiable-packet-v0.md.

completion.reason: Delivered on main before the wave: BUILD-LOG entry 'packet-trust-class' (decision 0346, TCP-V0-023, FPK-V0-032): one closed trust class per context evidence row and prove proof row; tainted rows satisfy no governance/basis and the refusal names the row; additive wire with old-consumer decode tests. Gap kept as text: query/impact rows and extevidence external rows are not stamped (byte-exact GPK-V0-002 parity).

title: packet: trust class per cited source so tainted sources never satisfy a basis
